fr_promulguer_verb.hook: Ding, ding! Monsieur Verbe the town crier PROMULGATES the new rule, sealed and official (proh-mewl-GAY).
fr_promulguer_verb.why: Promulgate → promulguer = to promulgate, to officially proclaim (a law). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Le maire promulgue la nouvelle règle.
The mayor proclaims the new rule.

fr_embellir_verb.hook: Flowers and bunting make the beach hut BELLE – Monsieur Verbe EMBELLISHES it (ahn-bay-LEER).
fr_embellir_verb.why: Belle = beautiful → embellir = to make more beautiful, to embellish. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.
ex: Les fleurs embellissent la cabine de plage.
The flowers make the beach hut prettier.

fr_inculquer_verb.hook: Bow, little puppy! Monsieur Verbe INCULCATES good manners, again and again (an-kewl-KAY).
fr_inculquer_verb.why: Inculcate → inculquer = to instil, to teach firmly. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il inculque la politesse à son chiot.
He instils good manners in his puppy.

fr_affiner_verb.hook: Turn the cheese, wait, turn again – Monsieur Verbe makes it FINER and finer: affiner (ah-fee-NAY).
fr_affiner_verb.why: Fin = fine → affiner = to refine, to hone; for cheese, to ripen. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il affine ses fromages à la cave.
He ripens his cheeses in the cellar.

fr_cristalliser_verb.hook: Sun on seawater leaves sparkling CRYSTALS – the salt CRYSTALLISES (krees-tah-lee-ZAY).
fr_cristalliser_verb.why: Crystallise → cristalliser = to crystallise. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Le soleil cristallise le sel de mer.
The sun crystallises the sea salt.

fr_differer_verb.hook: One round, one spiky – Monsieur Verbe's two shells DIFFER (dee-fay-RAY).
fr_differer_verb.why: Differ → différer = to differ; also to postpone. Regular -er (ils diffèrent): RED beret.
ex: Ces deux coquillages diffèrent.
These two shells are different.

fr_resorber_verb.hook: Shrink, shrink, gone – the sun REABSORBS the puddle (ray-zor-BAY).
fr_resorber_verb.why: Resorb, absorb → résorber = to absorb, to reduce, to get rid of gradually (also used for unemployment, a deficit). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Le soleil résorbe la flaque.
The sun makes the puddle disappear.

fr_valoriser_verb.hook: On a velvet cushion, the shell shows its true VALUE – Monsieur Verbe VALORISES it (vah-loh-ree-ZAY).
fr_valoriser_verb.why: Valeur = value → valoriser = to value, to showcase, to give worth to. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il valorise son plus beau coquillage.
He shows off his finest shell.

fr_amplifier_verb.hook: HELLO, HARBOUR! The megaphone AMPLIFIES Monsieur Verbe's voice (ahn-plee-FYAY).
fr_amplifier_verb.why: Amplify → amplifier = to amplify, to make louder or bigger. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Le porte-voix amplifie sa voix.
The megaphone amplifies his voice.

fr_extenuer_verb.hook: Phew! After the long walk Monsieur Verbe is completely EXHAUSTED – exténué (ehk-stay-NWAY).
fr_extenuer_verb.why: Extenuate (to thin out) → exténuer = to exhaust, to wear out. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Cette longue marche l'a exténué.
That long walk wore him out.

fr_indemniser_verb.hook: Oops, the cat's fish is gone – Monsieur Verbe INDEMNIFIES it with a fresh one (an-dehm-nee-ZAY).
fr_indemniser_verb.why: Indemnify → indemniser = to compensate (for a loss). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il indemnise le chat avec un nouveau poisson.
He compensates the cat with a new fish.

fr_piocher_verb.hook: Your turn! Monsieur Verbe PICKS a card from the deck (pyoh-SHAY).
fr_piocher_verb.why: Piocher = to draw (a card), to dig into; une pioche = a pick(axe), the draw pile. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_accaparer_verb.hook: All mine! Monsieur Verbe grabs and HOGS every bucket – he CAPTURES them: accaparer (ah-kah-pah-RAY).
fr_accaparer_verb.why: Accaparer = to monopolise, to hog (things, attention, the conversation). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il accapare tous les seaux.
He hogs all the buckets.

fr_chavirer_verb.hook: Oh no! The little sailboat tips over and CAPSIZES (shah-vee-RAY).
fr_chavirer_verb.why: Chavirer = to capsize, to keel over. Regular -er: RED beret.

fr_simplifier_verb.hook: From a tangled mess to one neat loop – Monsieur Verbe SIMPLIFIES (san-plee-FYAY).
fr_simplifier_verb.why: Simplify → simplifier = to simplify. Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il simplifie le nœud de sa corde.
He makes the knot in his rope simple.

fr_exceder_verb.hook: The needle is in the red: the suitcase EXCEEDS the limit (ehk-say-DAY).
fr_exceder_verb.why: Exceed → excéder = to exceed, to go beyond. Regular -er (il excède): RED beret.
ex: La valise excède le poids permis.
The suitcase is over the weight limit.

fr_submerger_verb.hook: Splash! The wave goes right over the top – it SUBMERGES everything (sewb-mehr-ZHAY).
fr_submerger_verb.why: Submerge → submerger = to submerge, to swamp, to overwhelm. Regular -er (nous submergeons): RED beret.
ex: La vague submerge son petit mur de sable.
The wave swamps his little sand wall.

fr_retrecir_verb.hook: Out of the wash, the jumper is tiny – it has SHRUNK, rétréci (ray-tray-SEER).
fr_retrecir_verb.why: Étroit = narrow → rétrécir = to shrink, to narrow. Regular -ir (nous …issons): GREEN beret.

fr_rallonger_verb.hook: Click, click, more rows – Monsieur Verbe makes the scarf LONGER: rallonger (rah-lohn-ZHAY).
fr_rallonger_verb.why: Long → rallonger = to lengthen, to extend. Regular -er (nous rallongeons): RED beret.
ex: Il rallonge son écharpe.
He makes his scarf longer.

fr_scinder_verb.hook: Like SCISSORS through the middle – Monsieur Verbe SPLITS the pile in two (san-DAY).
fr_scinder_verb.why: Scinder = to split, to divide (scission). Regular -er: RED beret.
ex: Il scinde le tas de coquillages en deux.
He splits the pile of shells in two.

fr_abreger_verb.hook: Look at the time! Monsieur Verbe rolls up his speech and makes it BRIEF – he ABRIDGES it (ah-bray-ZHAY).
fr_abreger_verb.why: Abridge → abréger = to shorten, to cut short (bref = brief). Regular -er (j'abrège): RED beret.
